observations: Photo 0 shows a black Nikon DSLR camera body with the Nikon logo on the prism, fitted with a large telephoto zoom lens marked Nikon AF-P.
Photo 1 shows the same camera from the rear; the lens barrel clearly reads 70-300mm and Nikon AF-P DX NIKKOR.
Photo 2 shows the camera from the side with visible wear on the grip leatherette; the Nikon logo is visible.
All three photos show the camera resting on a white box printed with McSteve Gadget Store.

claims.claim: Used Nikon D3400 DSLR Camera With 70-300mm Lens
claims.evidence: Nikon branding and 70-300mm lens markings are visible in photos 0 and 1, but the D3400 model number is not readable on the body

claims.claim: working perfectly ok with no fault
claims.evidence: Photos cannot demonstrate camera or lens function

risks.risk: Camera body may not power on, shutter may be faulty, or sensor may be damaged
risks.proof: Video of the camera turning on, navigating menus, and taking a photo

risks.risk: Lens may have fungus, element separation, scratches, or faulty autofocus, zoom, or vibration reduction
risks.proof: Close-up of front and rear lens glass under light, plus video of zoom and focus operation

risks.risk: Shutter count may be high or unknown
risks.proof: Photo of the camera information menu showing shutter count

risks.risk: Battery, charger, strap, or memory card may be missing or non-functional

proof_requests: Video of camera powering on, shooting, and reviewing images
Close-up of lens front and rear elements with light
Photo of camera info menu showing shutter count
Photo of battery, charger, and other accessories
response.reason: The item is identifiable as a Nikon DSLR with a 70-300mm lens from the photos, but the D3400 model and working condition cannot be verified remotely, so it is priced at worst case using the closest Nikon DSLR comparables.
